validation_rules: the candidate is submitted to T07 and has no authority before T07 accepts it
every assessment belongs to a fragment assigned by the exact pinned T06 handoff
every non-null verdict cites exact evidence available inside the bounded cell package
cannot_verify is used when the assigned static evidence cannot satisfy the proof obligation
dynamic requests remain inert and candidate followups do not create findings
the result cannot assert exploitability, severity, runtime state, remediation state, compliance or certification
